scripts.test: node scripts/test-blocklist.mjs && node scripts/test-core.mjs && node scripts/test-app.mjs && node scripts/test-draft.mjs && node scripts/test-media.mjs && node scripts/test-lang.mjs && node scripts/test-lexicon.mjs && node scripts/test-lexicon-scope.mjs && node scripts/test-build-web.mjs && node scripts/test-lexicon-baseline.mjs && node scripts/test-lexicon-picker.mjs && node scripts/test-german-expansion.mjs && node scripts/test-t19.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-lookup.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-store.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-editor-query.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-numerals.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-names.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-conjugation.mjs && node scripts/test-t19-packs.mjs && node scripts/test-presets.mjs
